tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on minimizing HTTP requests, compressing files, and leveraging browser caching. This task requires collaboration with the design team to ensure visual consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching mechanisms on the backend to reduce database queries and improve response times. This task requires careful consideration of cache invalidation strategies to ensure data consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests data, when the data is retrieved from cache, then the response time is under 500ms

tasks.description: Optimize database indexing to improve query performance. This task requires analysis of database query patterns and careful planning to minimize downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the execution time is under 1 second

tasks.description: Develop a dashboard to monitor and track performance metrics, such as load times, response times, and error rates. This task requires collaboration with the DevOps team to integrate with existing monitoring tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the dashboard, when the dashboard displays metrics, then the metrics are accurate and up-to-date

tasks.description: Develop automated testing scripts to simulate user interactions and measure performance metrics. This task requires careful consideration of testing scenarios to ensure comprehensive coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test script is run, when the test completes, then the performance metrics are reported accurately

tasks.description: Implement code splitting to reduce initial load times and improve responsiveness. This task requires careful consideration of code dependencies and splitting strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to a page, when the page loads, then the initial load time is under 1 second

tasks.description: Identify and optimize slow database queries to improve performance. This task requires careful analysis of database query patterns and collaboration with the database team.
acceptance_criteria: Given a slow query is optimized, when the query is executed, then the execution time is under 500ms
